title: Ravenholdt Manor
wikitext:
'''Ravenholdt Manor''' is the headquarters for the [[Ravenholdt]] [[faction]].

For those having trouble finding it, there is a plateau slightly northwest of [[Durnholde Keep]] in [[Hillsbrad Foothills]].   At the back of this plateau, where it meets the mountains (the Alterac Mountains, incidentally), you should find a small path leading up into the mountains (at coordinates 75,23).  This path twists back and forth, goes through a small cave, and then leads to Ravenholdt Manor.

See [[Ravenholdt]] for more information.
